tasks.title: Development Loop
tasks.purpose: Only authorized bounded repair; inspect canonical issue, branch and exclusive lease, then one reversible fix with regressions. No claim transfer, merge, release or speculative work.

tasks.title: Handoff Control
tasks.purpose: Inspect actual canonical handoff and candidate; identify stale or competing claims, one concrete existing Worker or owner action. Never take ownership.

tasks.title: Verification Watch
tasks.purpose: Inspect exact-head and proposed-merge runner logs, artifacts and review threads; identify changed verification only.

tasks.title: Audit Evidence
tasks.purpose: One bounded missing evidence gate per run; inspect actual artifact contents, hashes and historical scope. Never simulate independent acceptance.

tasks.title: Release Control
tasks.purpose: Reconcile release gates, permanent versions, closure, owner decisions, independent trial evidence, and current release status. Stop only after verified completion.
